meta.name: La caída de Diddy
meta.description: Durante décadas, Sean Combs, conocido artísticamente como Diddy o Puff Daddy, ha influido en la música y la cultura popular, desde sus inicios como creativo de talento hasta su detención en 2024. La docuserie explora las acusaciones de agresión sexual, comportamiento abusivo y violencia que recaen sobre él y que han conmocionado al mundo.

videos.title: The Making of a Mogul
videos.overview: The charges against Combs followed a series of lawsuits filed by multiple defendants accusing him of assorted misconduct. Combs has denied the claims and has pleaded not guilty. He is currently being held in federal custody in Brooklyn as he awaits trial,

videos.title: Empire Under Fire
videos.overview: Diddy’s business empire seems untouchable as it expands beyond music.

videos.title: Untouchable
videos.overview: Combs changes his name and rises to new heights on Broadway and reality TV, soon reaching billionaire status. However, behind his empire, people come forward with allegations of mistreatments like body shaming, physical abuse, sexual assault and brutal rape.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Publicly, Combs and Cassie become a power couple but witnesses reveal startling allegations of abuse by Combs toward Cassie kept quiet for years.

videos.title: The Assistant
videos.overview: Haunted by his time working for Diddy, a former assistant comes forward.
